tty: fix fu_list abuse
tty code abuses fu_list
column2: which causes a bug in remount

column1: If a tty device node is opened on a filesystem
column2: then the last link to the inode

column1: removed
column2: the filesystem will be allowed to be remounted readonly. This is

column1: because fs_may_remount_ro does not find the 0 link tty inode on the file sb
list (because the tty code incorrectly removed it to use for its own purpose).
This can result in a filesystem with errors after it is marked ""clean"".
Taking idea from Christoph's initial patch
at file->private_data and put our required list fields in there
file and tty. This makes tty nodes behave the same way as other device nodes
and avoid meddling with the vfs
The error handling is not trivial in the tty code
the simple approach of using __GFP_NOFAIL and don't worry about memory errors.
This is not a problem because our allocator doesn't fail small allocs as a rule
anyway. So proper error handling is left as an exercise for tty hackers.
[ Arguably filesystem's device inode would ideally be divorced from the
driver's pseudo inode when it is opened
column2: but in practice it's not clear whether

column1: that will ever be worth implementing. ]
